result.title: Learning High-Quality Pseudo-Labels for Point-Supervised Temporal Action Localization
result.summary: Point-supervised temporal action localization (PTAL) aims to recognize and localize action instances in untrimmed videos using only point-level annotations. Existing pseudo-label-based methods have made substantial progress in PTAL. However, confidence-based initialization can overlook well-localized proposals. Meanwhile, existing methods either keep pseudo-labels fixed during detector training or update them without fully exploiting alternative boundary evidence from the original proposal pool. These limitations constrain supervision quality, thereby hindering detection performance. To learn high-quality pseudo-labels, we propose a framework that integrates prior-guided initialization with consensus-guided refinement during detector training. Our framework comprises two modules: Prior-Guided Initialization (PGI) and Consensus-Guided Refinement (CGR). PGI combines proposal confidence with point-derived priors to establish instance-specific reliability for initial pseudo-label selection and candidate retention. CGR continually uses the retained original candidates to construct boundary targets, combining their consensus with evolving detector predictions to refine pseudo-labels throughout training. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves competitive detection performance compared with existing methods. In particular, our method achieves 68.5\% average mAP over tIoU thresholds 0.1--0.7 on THUMOS14, surpassing PseR by 3.7 percentage points. Code is available at https://github.com/zhenyingfang/LHQP

AI.brief_summary: 针对点监督时序动作定位，提出由先验引导初始化（PGI）与共识引导精化（CGR）组成的框架，用点级先验与候选池共识在训练中持续改进伪标签质量，并在四个基准上报告检测结果，THUMOS14 上平均 mAP 为 68.5%。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「候选保留—共识构造目标—随检测器演化迭代精化监督」的做法，可能为 LVR 中缺少精确中间监督时的 latent 轨迹训练与贡献分配提供线索；但任务是视频动作定位、不涉及多模态推理，迁移性需核查。
